scope.negative_result: No hit in the searched genotyped coding models; not proof of normal-tissue absence
scope.unphased_combinations: Potential self; conservatively exclude hits, do not claim measured phase

RNA_eligibility_check.scope: Exact altered-target peptide matches, including alternate contigs, pseudogenes, isoforms and bounded personal-normal models. CTA/self targets are outside this gate.

policy.agretopicity: Mutant nM / focal-reference nM on the same allele; no cutoff.
policy.flanked_scores: Sensitivity annotations with available recorded source context, never synthetic padding.
policy.splice_comparison: Best no-flank presentation among target peptide/allele pairs with fresh affinity <=500 nM; best window per gene. Existing weighted score, event_id and region_id break ties.
